outcome: Child gestational epigenetic age (EA) at birth
cohort: 271 maternal-child dyads in the Drakenstein Child Health Study, a South African birth cohort study
finding: Maternal PTSD was significantly and negatively associated with child gestational EA residuals at birth, after controlling for several factors.
mod_finding: Maternal PTSD was significantly and negatively associated with child gestational EA residuals at birth, controlling for [...] mode of delivery [...].
